heading: Tonight
text: Periods of showers, tapering off through NY and the St. Lawrence Valley. Lows in the 50s to near 60. East wind diminishing in the north, gusting 15 to 20 mph in the south.

heading: Thursday
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers likely east of the Greens, decreasing to the west. Highs in the low to mid 70s. Light northeast wind.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Any scattered showers becoming spotty. Mostly cloudy, becoming partly cloudy overnight as showers diminish. Lows in the 50s to near 60. Light north wind.
